Rich or spiritual? Most people think you must pick one.

Kevin Trudeau says we put those two into separate boxes: you are either going to be rich or you are going to be spiritual.

He points to the famous camel and the eye of the needle. In his telling, the needle was a gate into the city. The camel had to unpack, kneel and humble itself, and then everything came through with it.

So the old quote may be a misunderstanding of what it actually says.

Which of those two boxes did you grow up believing in?

Kevin's network for money and success thinking (GIN) is in my highlights.
